name: Protecting Our Places

administered_by.name: NSW Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water

summary: Two-stage grants for New South Wales Aboriginal community organisations to plan, then carry out, on-ground protection and restoration of culturally important landscapes and waterways.
reporting: A project implementation plan after the planning stage, progress reports for stages 2 and 3, and a final report with financial certification at project end.

pool.quote: A total of $1 million is available for the 2026 round of the program.

applicant_types.quote: The following NSW Aboriginal community organisations/groups may apply: NSW Local Aboriginal Land Councils (LALCs) NSW Aboriginal Corporations registered under the Corporations (Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander) Act 2006

geography.quote: We are dedicated to supporting proposals that provide meaningful benefits to the natural environment of New South Wales.

access.quote: If you plan to apply for a Protecting Our Places grant, the following resources will help you complete your application.

window.quote: Application opened: 15 June 2026 Application closed: 31 July 2026, 11:59 pm

amount.quote: Grants of between $150,000 to $250,000 can be awarded per project.

administered_by.quote: This program is administered by Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water.

reporting.quote: Stage 1 Planning $20,000 6 to 12 months Project Implementation Plan Stage 2 Implementation $115,000 12 months Progress Report -Stage 2 Stage 3 Implementation final payment $115,000 12 months Progress Report - Stage 3 Project end End of project Final Report and Financial Certification
